claims.text:
5. hidden-markov

Target / packet: ai-hidden-markov · P3. Prerequisites: probability:bayesian-updating.

Nearest / distinct payoff: bayesian-posterior-lines → ai-bayesian-posterior-lines. Posterior line inference lacks a changing hidden state; this alternates transition prediction and emission-based filtering.

Finite primary model: Hidden states Dry/Wet initial[.5,.5], transitions stay.8/switch.2, observation umbrella likelihood Dry.1/Wet.9. First umbrella posterior [.1,.9]; next predictive Wet=.1.2+.9.8=.74; another umbrella posterior Wet=.666/(.666+.026)=333/346.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: No second observation leaves predictive Wet.74. With uninformative emission likelihood.5 for both, observation does not change the prediction. Distinguish hidden-state filtering from observed-state transitions.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict whether two umbrellas increase Wet belief beyond .9; recall no-observation versus uninformative-observation equality.

Required observable evidence: Show prediction then emission-update steps and normalize visible masses, with only 2 states.
